# Support

For application defects, open a Bug report issue. For requested behavior, use the Feature request issue form. For security vulnerabilities, do not open a public issue; follow the private reporting instructions in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

When reporting an operational problem, include the deployment environment, approximate UTC time, affected route, and sanitized error code. Never include credentials, access tokens, student personal information, payment details, invoice PDFs, or unredacted logs.
